notes.d4-date-named-page-file-format: pending P2 (Martin, veto item): an ordinary page named like a date (pages/25-10-2026.md) is reached only by its own spelling in Tine; the model opens it for every spelling of that day because the harness's key function (`fold`, handed to the model as `keys`) folds every date spelling to the day. Tine's rule is kept in code until P2 is ruled.
notes.n1-legacy-codec: pending Q-N1 (Martin): OG keeps "%25" undecoded in a legacy file name ("50%25 of 100%"); Tine percent-decodes it ("50% of 100%"). Today's behaviour is kept until Q-N1 is ruled. ("contents" -> "Contents" was fixed in batch 3, REG-CM-CONTENTS-PAGE-NAME.)
notes.n2-triple-lowbar-codec: pending Q-N1 (Martin): decode differences from OG's triple-lowbar codec (a leading "___", percent-decoding, "______"). Today's behaviour is kept until Q-N1 is ruled.
notes.n4-org-file-links-triple-lowbar: A finding, not a decision (CM step 2 batch 6): `nearestLink` (follow link, Ctrl/Cmd+O) caches each block's link candidates per parsed AST (`candidatesByAst`), so after the graph's `:file/name-format` changes at runtime a block parsed before the change keeps the old format's page name for an Org file link. This test reads the same texts under legacy first, then triple-lowbar. Pre-existing; surfaced when this test moved off `pageRefsInText` (deleted). Fix: key the cache by the file-name format.
notes.n5-title-differs-from-stem: pending Q-N3 (Martin): OG names a journal file with `title::` by its title ("Release day"); Tine names every journal by its date. Today's behaviour is kept until Q-N3 is ruled.
